question: Which structural constraints explain finite predicate/decoder observations, and which additional, independently replicated comparison would distinguish the remaining alternatives?

primary_comparison.baseline: Current complete fixed-L compute.ungated_attempt, radius0/t0, with full blinding/conversion/public checks.
primary_comparison.candidate: Separately frozen incremental evaluator or bounded noisy-predicate/list/SFT procedure. Each candidate has its own declared question and costs.
additional_references: Matched working BSGS with declared setup/amortization/memory.
Uniform public candidate and both public checks.
primary_comparison.pairing: Same public curve/base/Qs and declared common blinding streams. Exact trace-equivalence study uses the same full query schedule. Algorithms with different query requirements retain and pay their actual schedules; do not force additional candidate-only queries into the ordinary baseline to manufacture a gain.

covariance.domain: p>3; nonsingular short Weierstrass; odd prime r!=p; u in Fp*; valid subgroup points.
covariance.status: derived from actual affine slope/Miller recurrence, one F11 known-answer software check; independent review pending.
covariance.warning: Do not mix weights from forward and inverse coordinate conventions. Compare all weighted answer fields, not just bits.

odd_mask_null.domain: Ready arm; p=3 mod4; odd prime-order subgroup. Identity bit0 is separate.
mask_conditions: If setup undefined retain a separate all-undefined outcome; do not force an anchor.
odd_mask_null.D: Number of defined nonidentity unordered +/- pairs.
odd_mask_null.sampling: Fix the anchor pair. Independent fair orientation bit on each remaining defined pair; complement at the negative. Keep mask exactly. Declare ideal-uniform versus implemented PRNG model, replacement, hashes, duplicate functions and costs.
odd_mask_null.small_support: If D=1 record a singleton and no randomization discrimination; no silent relaxation.
odd_mask_null.covariance: Transport the same assignment from a reference pointed chart by phi_u. Never redraw based on changed raw coordinates.
odd_mask_null.role: Validator-only synthetic conditional random-function reference. It is not an efficiently supplied scalar solver or a proven distributional null for random curves.
odd_mask_null.joint_arms: Declare and test any joint coupling. Independent per-arm nulls do not match shared Z/circuit/base dependence.

full_cocycle.statement: Same complete lambda cocycle and Z(O)=0 imply a unique Z on the r subgroup since Hom(Z/r,Fp)=0.
full_cocycle.proof: Difference D is additive; rD(R)=D(rR)=0; invertible r gives D(R)=0. With the same g recipe this null is degenerate.
full_cocycle.scope: Conditional algebra under stipulated full identity; not proof that source implements that identity.

trace_dependence.eta: Unconditional one-query wrong-or-erased fraction under uniform nonzero scalar.
trace_dependence.independence: (1-eta)^L is not inferred. Explicit clustered/ dispersed error controls with matched margins test an assumed joint error model.
trace_dependence.source: Derived union bound and the doubling permutation; no scientific data.

proposed_panel.purpose: Descriptive source-bound independent curve panel; not a power claim or admitted trial.
proposed_panel.eligibility: Lock ordinary nonsingular non-anomalous prime subgroup conditions and prior exclusion list; distinct(p,j) keys. Isomorphic copies are paired views, never new curves.
proposed_panel.proposal_limits: Must be prespecified and feasibility-checked before data; proposal-cap failures recorded as sampling/infrastructure outcomes.
proposed_panel.secondary_configurations: The other seven unchanged circuit/base multiplier arms; no coefficient/base/chart fitting.
proposed_panel.null_count_policy: Fixed, no optional stopping. A resource-justified alternative requires a separate frozen plan before data. Null duplicates/ties and actual support retained.
proposed_panel.discovery: All already seen curves and the selected F23/r17 domain remain discovery; none enters confirmation.
proposed_panel.split: Future training/selection, validation and confirmation separated by curve(p,j) and target-generation seeds. Lock procedure before accessing confirmation. A second confirmation replicate uses an independent locked curve sampler/seed.
primary_observables: Per-curve unconditional correct/wrong/erased rate and coverage.
Full trace error/erasure histograms and error placement on doubling action.
Capped decoder lists, public checks, zero-hit and undefined outcomes.
Cost/memory vectors for every success and failure.
secondary_observables: Prespecified nonzero Fourier summaries with DC removed; a dense diagnostic is fully charged and never presented as an efficient SFT solver.
proposed_panel.population_units: Curve is the generalization unit; target, generator, restart, chart, arm and null function are nested/paired units.

inference.default: Descriptive reference distributions and curve-level contrasts. No current p-value, general mechanism verdict or global family closure.
inference.fixed_curve_uncertainty: Fresh unbiased independent blinding can support a conditional restart model only under its stated RNG/sampling assumptions; zero counts retain an interval, never imply true q=0.
inference.population_uncertainty: Prespecify the curve population/sampler; distinct sampling without replacement needs its finite-population justification. Do not pool attempts as independent curves.

distribution_free_mean_precision.for_half_width_0_05: ceil(2*ln(40)/0.05^2)=2952 independent curve draws under the stated bound; no assertion128 has that precision.

randomization_assumptions: Specify the transformation group or explicit synthetic null law.
Prove/justify null invariance or label the comparison descriptive.
Include identity, replacement policy and ties.
Do not use a statistic-invariant or degenerate action as evidence.
inference.finite_rank: If an applicable exchangeable m-reference construction is actually justified: (1+#T_ref>=T_obs)/(m+1). Do not use a zero b/m claim.
inference.multiplicity: Declare every circuit, multiplier, scale, metric and selection rule. A max-statistic family requires the true joint null coupling. Valid marginal tests may be corrected without assuming independence; no correction repairs invalid marginal p-values.

isolation.target_seed_rule: When Q=[s]P is generated, the generating seed and scalar remain checker-private. Public blinding/query seeds are separate and reveal only known transformations.
isolation.candidate_process: Fresh nonprivileged UID; no private mount/read permissions; network disabled; no credentials; minimal environment; inherited FDs closed; fresh owned work directory; no sibling state.
isolation.private_permissions: Checker-owned directory0700 and files0600; truth absent from candidate args/env/logs/filenames/ordering.
premeasurement_probes: Candidate-UID truth file access returns permission denied without printing contents.
Candidate-UID checker environment/process access denied or absent by sandbox design.
Public parser rejects extra scalar/seed columns.
Inspect permitted FDs/mounts and ensure no private descriptor inheritance.
A/A full-output equality and permuted/interleaved case-order resets detect stale-state/cross-target caches.
isolation.failure_rule: A failed isolation probe stops execution with infrastructure/isolation status, never a mathematical outcome.

costs.renewal_model: S_curve+T_target+E[C_online]/q only with actual registered restart law; retain success-cost correlation and all failed attempts in E[C].
costs.observed_batch: Setup+target preparation+all online work divided by success EVENTS; also report unique target coverage separately, not the same estimand.
costs.qualification: Source-emitted counters require independent operation execution replay before claiming a counter advantage; clocks need a separate isolation/attestation plan. Witnesses, receipts and hash checks alone do not qualify either.
costs.null_instrumentation: Mask evaluation, reference table/lazy function state, hashes/PRNG, transport and lookups are explicit validator/control costs; do not reprice them as free candidate access.

instrument_success: Exact mask/anchor/negation consistency for every scheduled reference.
Correct full weighted covariance of answer fields and exact recovery witnesses; all fixed-L calls retained after undefined.
A/A exact outputs, all scheduled IDs and independent scalar checks pass.
Known wrong normalization/transport is caught at a full answer field even if final bits coincide.
criteria.instrument_failure: Any broken consistency/equivalence/leak/coverage condition invalidates the corresponding implementation/control comparison, with original outputs retained.
criteria.scientific_result: Report effect distribution, uncertainty, failures and costs regardless of direction. No advantage is required for a valid measurement.
inconclusive: Insufficient population precision or unresolved sampling model.
Counter execution replay or clock qualification absent.
Operational failure or incomplete planned coverage.
criteria.scoped_followup: A replicated deviation changes only its locked curve/circuit/control question. Marginal null behavior alone does not settle joint spectra, another decoder or the broader coordinate-aware ECDLP problem.

known_answer_software_check.scope: One existing disclosedF11 curve/point and its public u2 chart; deliberate wrong coefficient transport.
known_answer_software_check.command:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,json
sys.path.insert(0,'harness/classical_ecdlp_transfer_successor')
from constructor import prepare,normalized_miller_coefficient
from curve import Curve
m={'p':11,'a':1,'b':6,'r':13}; P=(2,7);R=(5,2);u=2;p=11
phi=lambda T:None if T is None else (u*u*T[0]%p,u*u*u*T[1]%p)
mp={'p':p,'a':pow(u,4,p)*m['a']%p,'b':pow(u,6,p)*m['b']%p,'r':13}
arm={'kind':'candidate','alpha':1,'beta':-4}
a=prepare(m,P,arm);b=prepare(mp,phi(P),arm)
x,_=a.evaluate(R);y,_=b.evaluate(phi(R));wrong_arm={**arm,'beta':u*u*arm['beta']%p};wrong=prepare(mp,phi(P),wrong_arm);w,_=wrong.evaluate(phi(R))
assert b.z_base==u*a.z_base%p and b.c==pow(u,-2,p)*a.c%p
assert y['z']==u*x['z']%p and y['g']==u*x['g']%p and y['anchor']==u*x['anchor']%p and y['normalized']==x['normalized'] and y['bit']==x['bit']
assert w['normalized']!=x['normalized']
print(json.dumps({'scope':'software known-answer metamorphic check only; no scientific panel','fixture':m,'P':P,'R_existing_2P':R,'u':u,'transformed_model':mp,'P_prime':phi(P),'R_prime':phi(R),'base_values':{'Z_P':a.z_base,'c':a.c},'transformed_base_values':{'Z_Pprime':b.z_base,'c_prime':b.c},'original_answer':x,'transformed_fixed_alpha_beta_answer':y,'deliberately_wrong_beta_u2_answer':w,'all_assertions_passed':True},sort_keys=True))
PY
